Are you interested in a meaningful and impactful career? Would you like to contribute to protecting people and the environment and accelerating a statewide transition to sustainable pest management? The Department of Pesticide Regulation (DPR) could be the place for you! The Department of Pesticide Regulation's (DPR) Enforcement Regional Office Branch is recruiting one Environmental Scientist in the Southern Regional Office (SRO) located in the city of Santa Ana.
  

  

Under the close supervision of the Senior Environmental Scientist (Supervisor), the incumbent will perform professional scientific analyses and fieldwork associated with appropriate use of pesticides; independently apply scientific methods and principles to identify, research, analyze, and develop science\-based solutions for compliance with complex regulatory pesticide issues; provide oversight of enforcement activities to maintain statewide uniformity; generate, analyze and evaluate scientific data for regulatory compliance with human health and environmental requirements to ensure protection of human health, non\-target organisms, food safety, surface/ground water, wildlife, and air quality.

There is field work performed requiring the ability to maneuver over uneven ground and work in outdoor conditions. Occasional statewide travel may be required. Occasional irregular work schedules may be required. Travel may include overnight stays several days each month.
  

  

**NOTE:** This position may be eligible for hybrid telework under Government Code 14200 for eligible applicants residing in California, subject to the candidate meeting telework eligibility criteria set forth in the CalEPA telework policy and/or future program need. Employees not residing in California are not eligible for telework. Regardless of telework eligibility, all employees may be required to report to the position’s designated headquarters location, as indicated on their duty statement, at their own expense.
  

  

Beginning July 1, 2026, it is anticipated the position will be office\-centered and employees will be expected to report to the office at least four days per week.

Do you have a desire to work to reduce waste and help protect the health and well\-being of California’s people and environment? Do you have the knowledge and skills to perform scientific, analytical and technical work to help affected parties achieve "compliance through assistance"?

Staff play a key role in assisting local governments, local education agencies, and non local entities such as state and federal agencies in achieving statutorily mandated waste diversion goals; educating, motivating and overseeing programs to increase public participation in all aspects of waste reduction, including waste prevention, recycling, and composting in addition to edible food recovery. jobs.title: Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
**Job Overview:**



APTIM Environmental \& Infrastructure, LLC is seeking a mid\-level Environmental Scientist on a full\-time basis to work at our Irvine, California office to to participate in a variety of environmental compliance tasks in support of our RCRA and state hazardous waste, non\-RCRA waste, regulated waste, hazardous materials management, and other environmental compliance media including auditing programs. The successful candidate will prepare technical and compliance reports and review reports completed by junior personnel. Assist in preparation of proposals, budgets, vendor/subcontractor selection, and other contract related items. Conduct technical and regulatory analyses and review analyses of junior personnel. Perform diverse fieldwork, including sampling inspections and audits. Apply expertise to both standard and unique situations, ensuring environmental standards are met across projects. Be expected to maintain current knowledge of environmental regulations and emerging developments. This role requires both independent work and collaboration with multidisciplinary teams to ensure compliance and provide clients with practical, science\-based solutions. Responsibilities may also include supervising junior staff and participating in leadership development opportunities. This position will primarily be in an office environment but may also require travel to client facilities conduct environmental compliance reviews/audits and/or gather related data.





**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities:**


* Executing and managing various work scopes, while meeting project schedules and budgets.
* Collection and interpretation/evaluation of scientific data.
* Executes field work within project schedule and budgetary goals and supervises subcontractors.
* Use various environmental databases and software to research project/site requirements and document the results in a technical report.
* Work independently and as part of a project team and be able to adjust to changing conditions or client requirements. Supervises junior staff on more complex work tasks.
* Adheres to established health and safety policies and procedures and executes work in a safe and conscientious manner.
* Understands technical concepts, evaluation results, plans, reports, and ensures conformance to applicable technical standards.
* Interfacing with client personnel at a corporate and facility level.
* Has in\-depth experience, knowledge, and skills in own discipline.
* Flexible and willing to support other projects as needed.
* Drafts technical documents for regulatory agencies and private clients.
* Providing guidance and oversight to junior staff.
* Applies knowledge and skills to more complex situations.
* Build and maintain successful client relationships.
* Work with clients to evaluate proposed projects for anticipated impacts, define type of environmental requirements needed and prepare proposals.
* Communications with regulatory agencies.
* Time management to ensure a quality product is prepared to meet project deadlines.
* Applies knowledge and skills to a wide range of standard and nonstandard situations.
* Following defined processes explicitly while also being able to identify and accommodate new or changing scenarios as well as developing processes for new activities.
* Specific experience with RCRA and state hazardous waste, non\-RCRA waste, and regulated waste compliance and national experience required.
* Prior experience or training regarding environmental compliance and related federal and state environmental regulations required.
* Experience with auditing is preferred.


**Basic Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in environmental science, a core science (such as geology, chemistry, physics, or biology), engineering, or related area required.
* Related work experience of 4\-6 years.
* Must have strong written and oral communication skills.
* Must have strong organizational skills.
* Strong computer skills required. Must have demonstrated strength and proficiency with Microsoft applications such as MS Excel, MS Word, SharePoint Online, and ability to learn other software applications.
* May be asked to work in the field and travel to complete work.

APTIM enhances the quality of the environment, wellbeing of people, resilience of communities, and opportunity for employees to make a difference, not just a living. A leading professional solutions firm, we specialize in environmental, sustainability, resilience, and infrastructure solutions. Our team of experts provide these integrated solutions for forward\-thinking government agencies, commercial and industrial clients, and energy customers. Together, we create sustainable and resilient communities for all.



What you can expect from APTIM:


* Work that is worthy of your time and talent
* Respect and flexibility to live a full life at work and at home
* Dogged determination to deliver for our clients and communities
* A voice in making our company better
* Investment into your personal and professional development


As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay range for this position is $90,000 to $100,000 per year. Compensation depends on several factors including: experience, education, key skills, geographic location of the position, client requirements, external market competitiveness, and internal equity among other employees within APTIM.

**At GHD, we don’t just believe in the power of commitment, we live and breathe it every day.**  

  

That’s why we pledge to empower all of our people to make a positive impact. Combining our deep technical expertise with the capabilities of our clients and partners, we respond to some of the most complex challenges facing our planet today.

**There’s no pledge more important than the one we make to look after our environment, and we’re committed to helping you do exactly that.**

Join us as we strive to ensure a sustainable future for our communities and the world we live in.

jobs.title: Geologist to compile historical information for 43-101 report
jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dedicated and detail\-oriented Geologist to lead the compilation and analysis of historical geological data for a 43\-101 report, a critical document that provides transparent and reliable mineral resource estimates. This role offers an exciting opportunity to apply your geological expertise, research skills, and technical knowledge to support mineral exploration and development projects. The ideal candidate will be passionate about environmental compliance, data interpretation, and geological modeling, ensuring all information is accurate, comprehensive, and compliant with industry standards. Join us to contribute to impactful projects that shape sustainable resource development.

**Duties**

* Collect, review, and synthesize historical geological data, including drill logs, assay results, geological maps, and previous exploration reports.
* Conduct detailed field research such as soil sampling, groundwater assessment, and site reconnaissance to gather supplementary data supporting the 43\-101 report.
* Utilize GIS software like ArcGIS and environmental modeling tools such as Petra to interpret spatial data and create detailed geological models.
* Prepare clear, precise technical reports documenting findings, methodologies, and interpretations in accordance with regulatory standards.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure environmental law compliance and integrate hydrogeological assessments into overall project planning.
* Support environmental remediation project management by providing geological insights and assisting with soil and groundwater investigations.
* Use AutoCAD for creating or updating geological maps and site layouts as needed for project documentation.

**Skills**

* Proven experience in geology with a strong background in field research, data collection, and geological modeling.
* Proficiency with GIS platforms such as ArcGIS and Petra for spatial analysis and mapping.
* Technical writing experience to produce comprehensive reports that clearly communicate complex geological information.
* Knowledge of environmental law, environmental compliance standards, and Hazmat regulations related to site investigations.
* Ability to interpret diverse datasets including soil sampling results, groundwater data, and historical exploration records.
* Familiarity with groundwater modeling tools like MATLAB or Python for hydrogeological assessments.
* Mechanical knowledge combined with construction experience enhances understanding of site operations and safety protocols.
* Experience with AutoCAD for mapping purposes; knowledge of MATLAB or Python is advantageous for data analysis tasks.

Join us in this vital role where your expertise will directly influence sustainable resource development while ensuring environmental integrity!

Pay: $51,860\.48 \- $62,455\.63 per year

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Geologist to compile historical information for 43-101 report
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dedicated and detail\-oriented Geologist to lead the compilation and analysis of historical geological data for a 43\-101 report, a critical document that provides transparent and reliable mineral resource estimates. This role offers an exciting opportunity to apply your geological expertise, research skills, and technical knowledge to support mineral exploration and development projects. The ideal candidate will be passionate about environmental compliance, data interpretation, and geological modeling, ensuring all information is accurate, comprehensive, and compliant with industry standards. Join us to contribute to impactful projects that shape sustainable resource development.

**Duties**

* Collect, review, and synthesize historical geological data, including drill logs, assay results, geological maps, and previous exploration reports.
* Conduct detailed field research such as soil sampling, groundwater assessment, and site reconnaissance to gather supplementary data supporting the 43\-101 report.
* Utilize GIS software like ArcGIS and environmental modeling tools such as Petra to interpret spatial data and create detailed geological models.
* Prepare clear, precise technical reports documenting findings, methodologies, and interpretations in accordance with regulatory standards.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure environmental law compliance and integrate hydrogeological assessments into overall project planning.
* Support environmental remediation project management by providing geological insights and assisting with soil and groundwater investigations.
* Use AutoCAD for creating or updating geological maps and site layouts as needed for project documentation.

**Skills**

* Proven experience in geology with a strong background in field research, data collection, and geological modeling.
* Proficiency with GIS platforms such as ArcGIS and Petra for spatial analysis and mapping.
* Technical writing experience to produce comprehensive reports that clearly communicate complex geological information.
* Knowledge of environmental law, environmental compliance standards, and Hazmat regulations related to site investigations.
* Ability to interpret diverse datasets including soil sampling results, groundwater data, and historical exploration records.
* Familiarity with groundwater modeling tools like MATLAB or Python for hydrogeological assessments.
* Mechanical knowledge combined with construction experience enhances understanding of site operations and safety protocols.
* Experience with AutoCAD for mapping purposes; knowledge of MATLAB or Python is advantageous for data analysis tasks.

Join us in this vital role where your expertise will directly influence sustainable resource development while ensuring environmental integrity!

Pay: $51,860\.48 \- $62,455\.63 per year

Work Location: Remote
